name: Amadeus for Developers
tagline: Self-serve travel APIs for flights, hotels, airports, and destinations
description: Amadeus for Developers provides self-service REST APIs for flight offers, hotel search and booking, airport and city lookup, destination content, and related travel data. Developers authenticate with OAuth2 client credentials, use a free test environment with monthly call quotas, and move to production after approval. Documentation covers endpoints, SDKs, and sandbox vs production hosts.

auth.details: OAuth2 client credentials: POST /v1/security/oauth2/token with grant_type=client_credentials, client_id, and client_secret; use Bearer access_token on API calls. Self-serve signup for test keys.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Test environment free with monthly free transaction quotas per API (varies by product; see pricing page); production billed after approval
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go production pricing per API after production access approval

use_cases: search flight offers between two cities for given dates
look up airport or city codes by keyword
search hotel offers by city or geocode
get cheapest flight destinations from an origin
retrieve airline or airport reference data
